purpose: Register cleaned teaching/evidence content and explicitly exclude older non-canonical files from runtime assembly.

legacy_runtime_exclusions.reason: Older principle framing contains claims that are too broad or insufficiently normalized by source/jurisdiction.
Older claim records contain mismatched/legacy source IDs and claim wording that is too broad for direct teacher-card assembly.

rules: Use v2 principle/claim files for all new runtime assembly.
Legacy files may remain in the repository for history but are not runtime sources.
New principles are selected by mathematical function/evidence rather than nationality.
New source claims preserve source authority and explicit non-use boundaries.
